Spice Money app · error explorer

Pick any of the 279 user-facing errors to see it on the screen where it appears, with the exact text the app shows. Errors come from the decompiled app (v6.6.62); screens behind them are rebuilt from the app's own layouts. Where the server writes the words, the text is shown as a [server text: …] marker. Rows with a staging-phone capture can be switched to the live screenshot. Rows tagged backend text have variants with the exact words Spice's backend sends for each bank / partner code (pick the filter "Has backend messages").

How to read the phone

Grey dashed tag “screen stand-in”: the screen behind the error is a simplified stand-in because the app builds that screen at runtime.
[server text: …]: wording sent by Spice's backend; not in the app.
Yellow note on the phone: the app shows no message in this case (silent block or redirect).
